andre-spicer.text: (2021) Campaign platform pledged to improve community policing and gang intervention and to 'activate a community led oversight committee made up of residents and legal advisors' to handle citizen complaints.

source.title: Andre Spicer for Mayor: Accomplishments / platform page

andre-spicer.text: His campaign site says he led efforts to shut down over 25 illegal marijuana dispensaries and initiated seizure of nuisance houses that had become havens for illegal activity.

source.title: Andre Spicer for Mayor: Accomplishments / platform page

andre-spicer.text: His campaign site lists 'Prioritized the removal of homeless encampments outside of schools' among his accomplishments, alongside connecting 142 residents with housing resources.

source.title: Andre Spicer for Mayor: Accomplishments / platform page

andre-spicer.text: (2021) Proposed a Garage Conversion Assistance Program: city loans up to $50,000 to convert garages into units housing homeless or low-income residents, with homeowners collecting up to $1,000 monthly rent.

source.title: Andre Spicer for Mayor: Accomplishments / platform page

andre-spicer.text: Campaign touts partnering with expungement clinics that helped over 600 residents clear criminal records for employment and housing.

source.title: Andre Spicer for Mayor: Accomplishments / platform page

andre-spicer.text: Backed raised Botts' Dots at street-takeover intersections, saying the fix should be 'a combination of that and the proper response from law enforcement.'

source.title: Andre Spicer for Mayor: home page (candidate statement)

andre-spicer.text: Opposed a proposed $85,000 city payment to the Compton Chamber of Commerce, saying giving it to organizations recently evicted from city facilities 'sounds like a political favor.'

source.title: 2UrbanGirls: Compton City Council delays decision on $85,000 Chamber of Commerce payout (Sep 2026)

andre-spicer.text: Says his 2021 recount and lawsuit exposed voter fraud in his council race and pledges to 'continue fighting to make sure your vote is always protected.'

source.title: Andre Spicer for Mayor: One Vote page

andre-spicer.text: Called for pausing action against the city manager until the full council receives formal legal guidance and the matter is properly agendized.

source.title: The Compton Bulletin: Spicer condemns actions against city manager (2026-04-13)

andre-spicer.text: Censured 4-0 by the council in May 2026 over Cal-Card misuse; called it a 'political attack' and had earlier offered a reimbursement of about $600 for some charges.

source.title: Wave Newspapers: Council censures colleague over credit card allegations (May 2026)

emma-sharif.text: After the June 2026 primary, told the Wave her priorities through November are infrastructure improvements, addressing deficiencies outlined in city audits, and continued transparency for residents.

source.title: Wave Newspapers: Sharif headed to runoff in Compton mayor's race (2026-06-03)

emma-sharif.text: Co-placed, with Councilman Bowers, a resolution censuring Councilman Spicer for Cal-Card misuse, revoking his card and referring findings to law enforcement; passed 4-0 in May 2026.

source.title: Wave Newspapers: Council censures colleague over credit card allegations (May 2026)

emma-sharif.text: Told The Bulletin the city has 'invested a lot of money into our infrastructure' to fix potholes, estimating fixing all streets would cost 'about one hundred million, plus.'

source.title: The Compton Bulletin: Is this the last stand for Mayor Emma Sharif? (2026-05-31)

emma-sharif.text: Told The Bulletin her main focus areas have been infrastructure, economic development and updating city parks.

source.title: The Compton Bulletin: Is this the last stand for Mayor Emma Sharif? (2026-05-31)

emma-sharif.text: (Jul 2025) At a city expungement fair: 'resources and second chances are life-changing,' opening residents to employment, housing and education opportunities.

source.title: The Compton Bulletin: Mayor Emma Sharif and Compton host expungement fair (2025-07-16)

emma-sharif.text: Announced the council placed City Manager Willie Hopkins on administrative leave pending an investigation (3-0 vote), declining details as a personnel matter.

source.title: 2UrbanGirls: Compton mayor issues statement on city manager being placed on leave (Apr 2026)
